units.turn: one authoritative actor turn, shared with owned summons

formulas.attack: faces 1-2 miss; 3-5 hit; 6 hit + exactly 1 extra point; no exploding dice
formulas.rerolls: reroll a miss at most once per base die; replace its result; hits/criticals never trigger another roll
formulas.modifiers: sum up to 16 signed flat and percentage modifiers in int64; clamp totals to [-8,8] and [-5000,5000] once; order independent
formulas.budget: grant=min(requestedRaw,actionDamageRemaining,ownerTurnDamageRemaining), charged before mitigation; zero granted stays zero
formulas.final: grant=0 => 0; otherwise ceil(grant*(10000-mitigation)/10000); armor cannot reduce a positive grant below 1
formulas.shield: separate finite pool of at most 12 points; absorbing damage does not refund the source budget
formulas.support: healing/shield grants have independent shared action/turn limits; overheal/unused shields do not refund spending

probabilities.sixDiceAllCriticalNoReroll: (1/6)^6; all criticals still produce only 12 points and at most 30 raw
probabilities.rollCount: at most 12 accepted die faces per attack; criticals add none; RNG rejection of excess uint values is not an extra game die

rng.algorithm: SplitMix64 upper uint32, unsigned unchecked arithmetic, d6 rejection sampling values<4
rng.saveState: persist ulong State after each command; constructor restores it exactly
rng.authority: server owns seed/state in online mode; determinism is not client authorization

invariants: All damage families and targets of an action share one ActionBudget; all owned entities share one TurnBudget.
One open action at a time; closing/end-turn invalidates old handles. No refund, reset or extra-AP API.
At most 3 paid actions, 60 outgoing raw, 18 healing and 12 granted shielding per owner turn.
AOE target iteration must be stable. Iteration order can distribute the fixed budget but never duplicate it.
Core uses integers, no floats, UnityEngine or Runtime/UI references; caps are mandatory and cannot be disabled by campaign modules.
Caller/server owns actor identity, turn lifecycle, targeting and commands. New TurnBudget construction is trusted engine work, not an anti-cheat gate.
worstBuild: 6 critical dice + power12 + flat8 + bonus50% requests 48 and is capped at 30/action, 60/turn. Multiple projectiles, AOE, pets, dots and reactions consume that same owner budget. With 60% mitigation at most 12/action from a 30 grant; no recursive crit or percent product. Rounding each small grant upward still cannot exceed granted raw.

referencesLocal.finding: Reference uses defense dice and hero cards; DungeonBDX defines its own bounded armor score instead of copying card values.
Dragon encounter objectives and limited scenario defense resources inform modular encounter contracts, not copied hero abilities.

limits: Mathematical invariants, not a claim of final PvP balance. Hero conversion and skills belong to stage 3; playable scene/HUD combat integration belongs to later gates. Native multiplayer/anti-cheat not implemented.
